hero.title: Elif Kaya
hero.subtitle: I work on the trace that light leaves behind.

about.title: Color speaks the language of memory
about.body: Born in Istanbul, she built her studio in Kuzguncuk. Working in oil and mixed media for over two decades, Elif Kaya's work carries the emotional residue of everyday moments onto large-scale canvases.

process.title: Every canvas begins with silence
process.body: Each piece takes shape through days of observation and charcoal studies. Layers of color accumulate over weeks; the final brushstroke lands months after the first idea.
process.step1Body: Light, texture, and the moment — recorded in the sketchbook.
process.step2Body: Ground colors are built up over weeks of patient work.
process.step3Body: The canvas is reworked until the composition settles.

contact.title: Let's talk about a piece
contact.body: For commissions, exhibitions, or collaborations, reach out to the studio directly.
